text:
Rina (ML): Morning! Accepted the org invite but when I try to push a branch I get `remote: Permission to redwood-inference/serving.git denied to rina.dev.` and `403`. I can fork but I'd rather push a branch directly. Who handles team mapping?
Cal (Platform): Hi @Rina — can you `gh auth status` and `gh api /user/memberships/orgs/redwood-inference` and paste the output? Quick check: sometimes the invite is on a different GH username or your email isn't verified.
Rina (ML): `gh auth status` shows I'm logged in as rina.dev and `saml: authorized`. The membership API returns "state":"active","role":"member" but trying to `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/rina/patch` returns 403.
Nikki (People Ops): We invited the username rina-redwood (work handle). Looks like you accepted on rina.dev instead. I can re-invite rina-dev or add rina.dev to the eng-ml team if you confirm it's the account you want to use.
Rina (ML): I prefer to keep personal and work separate — can we invite rina-redwood instead? I used my personal GH to accept earlier.
Cal (Platform): For a quick unblock: you can push via a fork (PR flow) — that's allowed even without write. If you want direct branch privileges we'll need People Ops to map the correct username to the invite and add you to team eng-ml. Also confirm 2FA is on for the account that will be added.
Nikki (People Ops): Sending new invite to rina-redwood now. Please accept and re-authorize SSO at https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/account_authorizations/new.
perm-bot: audit: invite created for rina-redwood (inv-8712).
Rina (ML): Accepted new invite and re-authorized SSO. Re-trying push... still 403.
Cal (Platform): Ok give us 30s; GitHub sometimes takes a short moment to apply team permissions after provisioning. If still blocked, I'll check team membership via the API and manually add repo write for eng-ml.
perm-bot: note: user rina-redwood provisioned and added to team eng-ml (audit id: add-334).
Rina (ML): Trying again — `git push` now succeeds. Thanks all!
Nikki (People Ops): I'll update the onboarding checklist: "Accept invite on your intended GH username, verify work email, enable 2FA, then authorize org SSO. If you accidentally accepted on the wrong account, request People Ops to re-invite the desired username."
Rina (ML): Happy to review the checklist edits. Closing the loop. :tada:
